body:
Rebased REDGARDEN main onto the upstream Codex PR that added docs/PING_SYSTEM_NORTHSTAR.md (written without this monorepo's own session context). Reviewed it -- the protocol/product design (tactical vocabulary, human input, server authority/fog-of-war integrity, wire event, delivery plan) holds up well and needed no rewrite. Extended §7's bot contract with real grounding: apps/arena_bot's actual squad code (hero_squad_count's my_owner % squad_count partition, hero_squad_target_node), and the RL policy's real scope (an additive movement nudge on the same deterministic heuristic bot, not a separate decision-maker -- v0 ping logic belongs entirely to the heuristic layer). Added an explicit determinism constraint: any bot-side ping timing/compliance variance must be a deterministic hash of (server_tick, owner_slot, purpose_tag), matching arena_game.c's own real item-curriculum-blend convention, never rand()/wall-clock -- required by the doc's own §9.4 replay-determinism test. Split the deeper 'how should bots respond to pings in a human-feeling way, especially for AI bot coordination' question into a new docs/BOT_HUMANNESS_NORTHSTAR.md, directly answering the founder's ask: ports MISHRI's real, shipped humanness layer (mood enum, reactionDelay/chatDelay split, APM throttle, imperfect compliance/ignoring, utility-scored decision cadence, cited by real function/file name) as design shapes, not code -- covers per-bot persistent temperament (derived deterministically from match_seed/owner_slot/hero_id), emission/consumption reaction delay, imperfect ping compliance bounded to never break squad-to-node legality, and squad-level speaker-election jitter. Explicitly scopes OUT bot chat/typos/AFK/gameplay-legality mistakes as non-transferable from MISHRI's live-social-bot context. Flags (does not fix) a real pre-existing gap against its own determinism bar: synergy_roll_tier already uses real rand(). Both docs registered in EMILY/context/golden-docs-index.md. REDGARDEN commit c20ea74, EMILY commit 59256700.

⚓ ☃
title: Ground Codex's Ping System Northstar in real code; split off Bot Humanness Northstar (MISHRI-derived)
